# Vendored front-end dependencies

These files are stored locally so the intranet application does not depend on public CDNs at runtime.

- Font Awesome Free 6.0.0 — https://fontawesome.com/license/free
- Bootstrap JavaScript bundle 5.3.0 — https://getbootstrap.com/docs/5.3/about/license/
- Chart.js 4.5.1 — https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js/blob/v4.5.1/LICENSE.md

Do not replace these files with unpinned CDN URLs. When upgrading, update the version query strings in templates and rerun the application UI tests.
